items.title: WSJ：Anthropic 7 位创始人 IPO 各套现约 2.5 亿美元并保留控制权
items.description: WSJ 报道，Anthropic 7 位创始人将在 IPO 中各出售约 2.5 亿美元股票，每人保留约 180 亿美元持仓。据公司文件，每人出售近 3.4M 股，发行价区间预计 70 至 78 美元，上市预计下周进行，估值接近 1.3 万亿美元，募资 800 亿美元以上，部分通过包括 Google 在内的私募配售。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/ajjv9abs8vd20j05emcig98ai

items.title: Anthropic 投资需求火热，承销商拟将 IPO 目标估值上调回 $1.5T 或更高
items.description: FT 报道，因投资者需求旺盛，Anthropic 承销商计划上调 IPO 定价，把目标估值拉回 $1.5T 或更高。周二文件设定 $70-$78 的发行区间，计入员工期权和受限股后对应 $1.26T-$1.41T 估值；若定价超出区间，募资将超过 $100B，其中 Google、Nvidia 和 Microsoft 将按 IPO 价格投资 $26B。  阅读原文 via AIHOT · https://aihot.news/items/m7ul4psbkb5zyp0t254fr986o

items.title: 谷歌为 Android XR 智能眼镜推出全面隐私保护措施：录制指示灯、人脸模糊与数据即删
items.description: IT之家 11 月 12 日消息，谷歌与 Warby Parker、Gentle Monster 合作推出的首款 Android XR 智能眼镜，正面临一个不太容易解决的问题：如何摆脱消费者对智能眼镜的隐私担忧。 由于早期进入这一领域的厂商没有充分重视隐私保护，智能眼镜逐渐背上了“偷拍眼镜”的负面标签。部分用户甚至将其视为侵犯他人隐私的工具。 以 Meta 智能眼镜为例，这款产品曾因被不法分子滥用而饱受争议。一些人会设法关闭眼镜上用于提示正在拍摄的 LED 指示灯，或者利用眼镜做出令人反感的行为。Meta 此前对录制内容的处理方式也曾引发隐私争议。这些问题叠加在一起，让消费者对智能眼镜产生了不信任，也使其背上了负面社会标签。 谷歌其实也不是毫无前车之鉴。早在第一代 Google Glass 推出时，用户就曾因佩戴这款眼镜而遭到嘲讽，甚至被冠以“Glasshole”（可理解为戴着智能眼镜四处惹人反感的人）的称呼。显然，谷歌从当年的经历中吸取了不少教训。 这其实有些可惜，因为摄像头对于智能眼镜而言具有很强的实用价值。用户可以用它随手拍照，而内置 AI 助手也能借助摄像头理解用户眼前的环境。

items.content: 就在刚刚，据彭博社报道，字节正在筹备一款类似 Meta Muse 的个人 AI Agent（智能体），希望在新一轮 AI 竞争中追赶对手。 用户只需要告诉它想去哪里，就能通过豆包查询机票、购买火车票、叫车，甚至预订酒店。过去需要在几个 App 之间来回切换的操作，如今开始集中到一个聊天框里。 据财新此前披露，字节内部早在今年 4 月就启动了代号为「Spell」的项目，主要由豆包手机助手团队负责，探索个人 AI 助理的产品形态。 9 月初，Meta 推出个人智能体 Muse 后，字节进一步加快了项目进度，并计划让 Spell 项目与豆包对话团队合作，将相关功能整合进豆包。 用户可以交代一项需要花费数天甚至数周的任务，让 Muse 自行规划步骤、搜索信息、调用外部服务，遇到需要确认的环节时，再向用户发来消息。 为了支撑这种运行方式，Meta 还为 Muse 准备了专门的云端虚拟机系统 Muse Secure VM。每个智能体都有独立的执行环境，可以在用户授权范围内使用浏览器、访问外部服务，持续处理尚未完成的工作。

items.content: 就在刚刚，Google DeepMind 正式宣布， 旗下最新旗舰模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 正式面向开发者、企业、科研人员及普通消费者提供服务。 Carbon 是目前 Gemini 家族综合能力最强的公开上线模型，尤其擅长复杂编程、网络安全、科学推理，以及需要长时间执行的多智能体任务。 与此前发布的 Gemini 4 Argon 相比，Carbon 主要面向复杂软件工程、跨领域研究等高难度任务，能够消耗更多 Token 进行深入推理、反复验证和错误修正，而 Argon 继续承担大多数日常编程和知识工作。 在 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity WANDR 和 Zapier AutomationBench 三项基准测试中，Carbon 均排名第一，单任务成本比表现次优的外部竞争模型低了一半以上。 价格方面，Carbon 的 API 优惠价格与 Argon 相同，每百万输入 Token 为 2 美元，每百万输出 Token 为 10 美元，12 月 1 日起将分别调整至 4 美元和 20 美元。 谷歌为此在 AI 编程平台 Google Antigravity 中推出了 /swarm 功能预览版，开发者输入一条指令，就能组织多个 AI Agent 分工执行任务，并实时查看进度。

items.description: This is Fireworks' second data breach in as many months.
items.author: Zack Whittaker
items.content: A cyberattack at Fireworks AI has exposed some of its customers’ data, the company has confirmed. Fireworks AI, a platform that developers use to access and use open AI models, said an attacker breached its cloud provider to gain access to a Fireworks development system, which allowed access to some of its customers’ data. The company said in its latest security advisory that the cybercriminals took Fireworks’ customers’ billing information and some datasets. Fireworks touts tens of thousands of customers worldwide using its platform, including legal tech company Harvey and AI company Cursor. At least one confirmed affected customer is online document editor and notetaker Notion, which said in a disclosure that the breach affected around 1% of its own customers. Notion said that Fireworks alerted the company to a security incident and later confirmed that the hackers had stolen some Notion customer data. On November 3, Notion said it disconnected its systems from Fireworks, deleted the data stored in its systems, and stopped all connectivity between the two. Notion confirmed this week that the hackers took chat transcripts of its Notion AI customers who used the “Insights” feature. The company said that the transcripts include “any input to or output from the model that was written to the chat is included in that chat transcript,” but added that much of the data was unattributable and could not be determined from which customer it was obtained. Voinosis, which develops AI to detect changes in brain health through voice analysis, won the competition. The other eight startups are listed below in alphabetical order. Voinosis is developing an AI tool that analyzes speech patterns such as pitch, pauses, rhythm and response times to detect changes linked to brain health. items.description: As soon as Wednesday evening, Nvidia's board could decide to remove its founder and CEO of 33 years.
items.author: Amanda Silberling
items.content: Nvidia is reportedly planning to oust its co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang, who has led the company for the last 33 years, the Wall Street Journal reports . Sources told the newspaper that the Nvidia board is meeting as soon as Wednesday to determine Huang’s future at the company. On Sunday, Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair with a woman purported by U.S. intelligence to be a Chinese spy. On Wednesday evening, the New York Times reported that Huang also had an affair with an executive who reports to him. Nvidia has become one of the most valuable companies in the world as it designs the chips that power the AI boom, but in the midst of Huang’s ongoing scandal , Nvidia stock fell about 8% in after hours trading on Wednesday. The stock is down about 11% in the past five days. Huang famously delegates very little and has about 60 direct reports, he has said . The company also has not had an obvious successor or a succession plan. According to Bloomberg, Nvidia is working with an outside firm to identify candidates that could potentially replace Huang as CEO. items.title: Jensen Huang accused of having another affair — with an Nvidia exec
items.description: Jensen Huang, who has come under fire for admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, has been accused of having a separate affair with an Nvidia subordinate.
items.author: Lucas Ropek
items.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is already under investigation after having admitted to having an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy . Now the New York Times is reporting that Huang is also suspected of having another extramarital affair, with a direct report of his at the company — Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare. Powell, like Huang, is married, the outlet says. The Times says it was told of the alleged affair by five employees at the company. The sources said that Huang and Powell were captured on video “being affectionate at a San Jose, Calif., hotel” during a conference earlier this year. Like many companies, Nvidia has rules discouraging superiors from having relationships with employees in subordinate roles, the Times notes. TechCrunch reached out to Nvidia for comment. The company’s board has initiated an investigation into Huang’s publicly admitted affair. Additionally, two House Republicans said Wednesday that Congress is gearing up to subpoena Huang over the spy allegations if he doesn’t voluntarily respond to their summons to a closed-door briefing. Late Wednesday, after the reports of the second affair were published, the Wall Street Journal reported that the Nvidia board was preparing to oust Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993.
